info.title: AutoReach API
info.description: REST API for the AutoReach career automation and outreach platform. All JSON keys are camelCase and every response uses the standard envelope.

202.description: Check the inbox for a verification link

post.description: When email verification is on (AUTH_REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION, the default in production) the answer is always 202, whether or not the address already has an account, so signup cannot be used to find out who is registered. A verification link (or, for a verified account, a notice) is emailed and the account can sign in once the link is opened. With verification off, the account is created at once (201) and an address already in use answers 409.

post.summary: Exchange credentials for a session
post.description: Answers 403 for a correct password while the email address is not verified yet.

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token and issue a new session
post.description: Each refresh token is single-use. Presenting a token that was already used revokes every token descended from the same login.

post.summary: Revoke the session the refresh token belongs to

delete.summary: Delete your account and everything it holds
delete.description: Needs the password. Deletes the user and the candidate profile with its resumes (and their files), mailboxes, templates, campaigns, messages, applications and matches. Administrator accounts answer 409. Shared contacts and suppressions that protect recipients stay.

get.summary: Get a candidate profile

post.summary: Ingest job postings in bulk
post.description: Accepts up to 500 postings. The whole request is validated first: if any posting is invalid the request is rejected with 422 and `error.details` names each failing field as `jobs[<index>].<field>`. Valid requests are upserted by job hash (company domain + normalised title) and queued for embedding. A posting that is already stored and embedded produces no task.

delete.summary: Erase a contact on their request
delete.description: Deletes the contact with their job links, messages and events, and adds their email address to the global suppression list so they are never contacted again.

get.summary: List the bounces, replies and LinkedIn responses candidates reported for a contact
get.description: Signals with appliedAt null have not changed the shared contact yet.

post.summary: Apply one candidate's report to the shared contact
post.description: A bounce suppresses the address for every candidate, drops it from the contact and looks for a current one; a reply or LinkedIn response confirms the contact. Applying a signal that was already applied changes nothing.

post.summary: Confirm an email address from the emailed verification link
post.description: The frontend page at AUTH_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_URL posts the link's token here; the user then signs in. Links expire after AUTH_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_TTL.

post.summary: Email a password reset link
post.description: Always answers 202, whether or not the address has an account, so it cannot be used to find out who is registered. An active account gets a link to AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_URL that works for AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TTL.

202.description: If the address has an account, a reset link was emailed

post.summary: Set a new password from the emailed reset link
post.description: The link works once: it is tied to the password it was issued for. Resetting marks the email verified and signs the account out everywhere.

get.summary: Download everything held about you

put.description: Needs the current password (403 when wrong). Ends every session; sign in again with the new password.

post.summary: Start moving your account to a new email
post.description: Needs the password. Emails a link to the new address (AUTH_EMAIL_CHANGE_URL); the page confirms it with POST /api/v1/users/me/email/confirm while signed in. An address that already has an account gets nothing, with the same answer.

202.description: Confirmation sent to the new address

post.summary: Confirm a new email address from the emailed link
post.description: Signed in as the account the link was sent for. Moves the account to the new address, marks it verified and tells the old address. The link works once; 409 if the address was taken meanwhile.

issue.example: must be a valid email address

roles.description: Role names. Permissions are resolved from these on the server.

linkedinProfileUrl.description: https linkedin.com URL. An empty string clears the value.

settings.description: Merged into the stored settings: each key given replaces that key, a key set to null removes it, and keys not given are kept. applicationProfile is ignored here; use PUT /candidates/{candidateId}/application-profile.

externalUrl.description: Public https URL. For GREENHOUSE, LEVER and WORKDAY the host must belong to that ATS.

status.description: DEFERRED means the queue was unreachable; the reconciler enqueues the task later.

parsedMetadata.description: Empty until the resume is parsed.

parsedBy.description: The parsing model, or "dictionary" when the skill list fallback was used.

lastInteractionAt.description: Last reply or LinkedIn response from this person

emailConfirmedAt.description: When a reply proved the current email address works; cleared when the address changes or bounces

linkedinConfirmedAt.description: When the person accepted an invite or replied on LinkedIn

anonymizedAt.description: Set when retention removed this contact's personal details; their outreach history is kept

password.description: Stored encrypted with AES-256-GCM; never returned.

smtpSecurity.description: NONE is accepted only when OUTREACH_ALLOW_INSECURE_MAIL is enabled (never in production).

imapSecurity.description: NONE is accepted only when OUTREACH_ALLOW_INSECURE_MAIL is enabled (never in production).

CreateTemplateRequest.description: Placeholders: {{candidateName}}, {{candidateFirstName}}, {{candidateLinkedinUrl}}, {{contactName}}, {{contactFirstName}}, {{contactTitle}}, {{companyName}}, {{jobTitle}}, {{matchingSkills}}. Any other placeholder is rejected.

body.description: At most 300 characters for LINKEDIN_CONNECT (a connection note).

UpdateTemplateRequest.description: Changing the subject or body of an APPROVED template returns it to DRAFT.

CreateCampaignRequest.description: A candidate has at most one ACTIVE campaign; it is used for automatic outreach. Steps may mix EMAIL, LINKEDIN_CONNECT and LINKEDIN_DM templates; each contact gets only the steps it can be reached on, and a LinkedIn message waits until the connection request is confirmed accepted.

CreateOutreachMessagesRequest.description: Creates one message per channel. EMAIL needs subject and emailBody and a verified mailbox; LINKEDIN_CONNECT needs linkedinNote (at most 300 characters after placeholders); LINKEDIN_DM uses emailBody as the message. LinkedIn channels need a contact with a LinkedIn profile. Text may use template placeholders.

status.description: Only PENDING or PAUSED messages can be cancelled.
ACTION_REQUIRED: a LinkedIn item the candidate must send in LinkedIn and confirm (assisted mode). ACCEPTED: the candidate confirmed the connection request was accepted.
SENT from ACTION_REQUIRED; ACCEPTED (connection requests) from ACTION_REQUIRED or SENT; REPLIED from any of those, which pauses the remaining steps to the contact.

contact.description: Who the message is for, including the LinkedIn profile to open for ACTION_REQUIRED items.

ApplicationProfile.description: Answers used to fill application forms. Questions are matched by label keywords; `answers` holds exact answers keyed by question label.

status.description: SUBMITTED from ACTION_REQUIRED or FAILED (the candidate submitted it); INTERVIEWING from SUBMITTED; REJECTED from SUBMITTED or INTERVIEWING.
ACTION_REQUIRED: answers are prepared; the candidate submits with applyUrl and confirms.

boardToken.description: Greenhouse board token, Lever site, Ashby job board name, SmartRecruiters company identifier, Workday site as {tenant}.{instance}/{site} (for example nvidia.wd5/nvidiaexternalcareersite), Adzuna country code, or the https URL of a careers page or sitemap

searchQuery.description: Adzuna search terms, or a URL filter for career page sitemaps

companyName.description: Not set for ADZUNA, whose jobs name their own company

CreateJobSourceRequest.description: companyName and companyDomain are required for every board type except ADZUNA, where they are not allowed. searchQuery is required for ADZUNA and optional for CAREER_PAGE.

boardToken.description: Greenhouse board token, Lever site, Ashby job board name, SmartRecruiters company identifier, Workday site as {tenant}.{instance}/{site} (for example nvidia.wd5/nvidiaexternalcareersite), Adzuna country code, or the https URL of a careers page or sitemap

skipped.description: Jobs that failed validation, including those whose company domain could not be resolved

closed.description: Jobs the board no longer lists

unchanged.description: Jobs still listed that were not re-read (SmartRecruiters)

responseRatePercentage.description: recruiterResponses / coldEmailsSent x 100, two decimals; 0 before any email is sent

nextCursor.description: Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page

latencySeconds.description: Age of the oldest pending task

deliverabilityPercentage.description: (sent - bounced) / sent x 100; null before any email is sent

candidateId.description: null for entries that apply to every candidate

value.description: An email address for EMAIL, a domain for DOMAIN

candidateId.description: Limit the entry to one candidate; omit for every candidate

ContactSignal.description: What one candidate observed about a shared contact. It changes the contact once enough candidates report the same thing (CONTACT_SIGNAL_CONFIRMATIONS) or an admin applies it.

address.description: The address that bounced or replied; empty for LinkedIn

appliedAt.description: null until the signal has changed the shared contact

token.description: The token parameter from the emailed verification link
The token parameter from the emailed reset link
The token parameter from the emailed link

email.description: The email parameter from the emailed link

resumeId.description: null once the resume was deleted

UserDataExport.description: Everything held about the signed-in user. Secrets (password hash, mailbox credentials, stored file keys, tracking tokens) are never included.

CampaignRecord.description: A campaign as stored; its steps are returned by the campaign endpoints.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required or has failed

RateLimited.description: Too many requests. Retry-After gives the seconds to wait.

UpstreamRejected.description: An upstream provider rejected the request

PayloadTooLarge.description: Request body or uploaded file is too large

ServiceUnavailable.description: A dependency the request needs is temporarily unavailable

BadGateway.description: The job board rejected the request (for example, an unknown board token)

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the request may be retried.

RateLimit.description: Remaining allowance per policy (draft-ietf-httpapi-ratelimit-headers): r is the requests left and t the seconds until one more is available, for example "user";r=42;t=1.

RateLimitPolicy.description: Policies applied to the request, for example "user";q=600;w=60.
